title: BitFlat: Error-Localized Bitstream Design for Robust Diffusion Image Compression
title_zh: BitFlat：面向鲁棒扩散图像压缩的差错定位比特流设计

paragraphs.en: BitFlat提出免训练的差错定位码流设计，使扩散图像压缩在低码率下对比特翻转保持鲁棒并提升重建质量。 Zero-shot diffusion image compression based on reverse channel coding achieves high perceptual quality at low bitrates without retraining, yet its bitstream remains vulnerable to bit flips. Prior work has shown that a joint combinatorial representation can amplify a single bit flip into substitutions of multiple atoms and that indexing each atom independently confines this error propagation. However, independent indexing reduces the number of atoms that fit within the bit budget and gives the decoder no indication of which atoms are corrupted. To address these issues, we propose BitFlat, a training-free error-localizing bitstream framework with two components. Blockwise Locality Alignment (BLA) decomposes the globally coupled atom selection at each diffusion step into independent selection units, each describing one signed atom from a dedicated codebook with a fixed-width field, so that any bit error affects only the unit in which it occurs. Reliability-Aware Diffusion Control (RADC) uses the bits saved by BLA to impose structured valid-codeword constraints within each field and converts the decoding state of each field into a binary reliability gate, which turns detected corrupted atoms into erasures at known positions and excludes them from noise synthesis. BitFlat requires neither target residuals nor additional network forward passes and leaves the diffusion model unchanged. Experiments on Kodak, DIV2K, and CLIC2020 show that BitFlat outperforms conventional, learned, and diffusion-based codecs at bit error rates from $10^{-4}$ to $10^{-2}$ and, even with $26.7\%$ fewer bits, surpasses Robust Turbo-DDCM.
paragraphs.zh: BitFlat提出免训练的差错定位码流设计，使扩散图像压缩在低码率下对比特翻转保持鲁棒并提升重建质量。基于反向信道编码的零样本扩散图像压缩无需重训练即可在低码率下实现高感知质量，但其码流仍易受比特翻转的影响。 已有工作表明，联合组合表示会将单个比特翻转放大为对多个原子的替换，而对每个原子独立索引可限制这种错误传播。 然而，独立索引减少了比特预算内可容纳的原子数量，且无法向解码器指示哪些原子被破坏。 为解决这些问题，我们提出BitFlat，一个包含两个组件的免训练差错定位码流框架。 块内局部性对齐（BLA）将每个扩散步骤中全局耦合的原子选择分解为独立的选擇单元，每个单元用固定宽度的字段从专用码本中描述一个带符号的原子，从而使任何比特错误仅影响其所在的单元。 可靠性感知扩散控制（RADC）利用BLA节省的比特在每个字段内施加结构化的有效码字约束，并将每个字段的解码状态转换为二进制可靠性门控，将检测到的被破坏原子转化为位置已知的擦除，并将其排除在噪声合成之外。 BitFlat既不需要目标残差，也不需要额外的网络前向传播，且不改变扩散模型。 在Kodak、DIV2K和CLIC2020上的实验表明，在比特错误率从$10^{-4}$到$10^{-2}$的条件下，BitFlat优于传统编解码器、学习型编解码器和基于扩散的编解码器，并且即使比特数减少$26.7\%$，仍超越Robust Turbo-DDCM。
